achievements.label: Beyond the Tribe
achievements.description: Guide the settlement into the Agrarian era.

achievements.label: Among the Stars
achievements.description: Reach the Space Age — the far end of the arc.

achievements.label: Thriving
achievements.description: Reach a Thriving sustainability score (85 or higher) at least once.

achievements.label: Phoenix Settlement
achievements.description: Recover from a Collapsing sustainability score all the way back to Steady or better.

achievements.label: Provision Tradition
achievements.description: Research at least 8 nodes in the Provision branch of the research tree.

achievements.label: Community Tradition
achievements.description: Research at least 8 nodes in the Community branch of the research tree.

achievements.label: Craft Tradition
achievements.description: Research at least 8 nodes in the Craft branch of the research tree.

achievements.label: Root and Branch
achievements.description: Research every node in the tree, across all seven eras.

achievements.label: Equity's Champion
achievements.description: Reach an Equity score of 90 or higher with a population of at least 25.

achievements.label: Built to Last
achievements.description: Reach a Resilience score of 85 or higher.

achievements.label: Full Coordination
achievements.description: Fully staff every Canal with Administrators (Classical era or later).

achievements.label: Nobody Exposed
achievements.description: Build enough Public Works to cover the whole settlement against a bad season (Medieval era or later).

achievements.label: Well-Designed Rings
achievements.description: Fully staff your Habitat Rings with Architects (Space Age).

achievements.label: A Real City
achievements.description: Grow the settlement's population to 100 or more.

achievements.label: Looking Back
achievements.description: Revisit a completed era to see how it's held up.
